Q: My VPN keeps disconnecting, what should I do?
A: Try reconnecting via the GlobalProtect client; if the issue persists, raise a ticket under "Network > VPN" and IT will investigate within 4 business hours.

Q: How do I reset my company email password?
A: Go to the self-service portal at password.shopunow.com and follow the OTP-based reset flow; this works for email, VPN, and intranet logins.

Q: My laptop won't turn on, who do I contact?
A: Raise a hardware ticket under "Hardware > Laptop Issue" on the IT portal; a technician will reach out within the same business day for on-site or courier replacement.

Q: How do I request a new software license?
A: Submit a request via the IT portal under "Software > License Request", specifying the software name and business justification for manager approval.

Q: I'm locked out of my account after multiple failed logins, what now?
A: Accounts auto-unlock after 30 minutes, or you can raise an urgent ticket under "Access > Account Lockout" for immediate unlocking.

Q: How do I set up email on my personal phone?
A: Install the Outlook app, use your shopunow.com email and password, and approve the MFA prompt sent to your registered device.

Q: What do I do if I suspect a phishing email?
A: Do not click any links; forward the email to phishing@shopunow.com and delete it. IT Security will investigate and notify if any action is needed.

Q: How do I get access to a shared drive or folder?
A: Submit an access request via the IT portal under "Access > Shared Drive", tagging your manager as the approver.

Q: My video conferencing app is not working during a call, who can help urgently?
A: Call the IT helpdesk hotline at extension 4455 for urgent live-meeting support in addition to raising a ticket.

Q: How often are laptops refreshed/replaced?
A: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years as part of the standard hardware lifecycle, or sooner if there's a verified hardware fault.

Q: Can I install personal software on my company laptop?
A: Only software approved on the IT catalog can be installed; unapproved software requires a one-time exception request via the IT portal.

Q: How do I connect to the office printer?
A: Install the printer driver from \\printserver\shopunow and select the printer nearest your floor; contact IT if it doesn't appear in the directory.
